arxiv-2005-08255.title: Dynamical modelling and analysis of COVID-19 in India
arxiv-2005-08255.creator: R. Gopal 1 , V. K. Chandrasekar 1 and M. Lakshmanan 2
arxiv-2005-08255.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by R. Gopal 1 , V. K. Chandrasekar 1 and M. Lakshmanan 2. We consider the pandemic spreading of COVID-19 in India after the outbreak of the coronavirus in Wuhan city, China. We estimate the transmission rate of the initial infecting individuals of COVID-19 in India by using the officially reported data at the early stage of the epidemic with the help of Susceptible (S), Exposed (E), Infected (I), and Removed (R) population model, the so called SEIR dynamical model.

arxiv-2012-15536.title: Rydberg atom-ion collisions in cold environments
arxiv-2012-15536.creator: Henrik Hirzler, Jesús Pérez-Ríos
arxiv-2012-15536.description: Abstract Low-energy collisions of Rydberg atom-ion systems are investigated theoretically. We present the parameter space associated with suitable approaches for the dynamics of Rydberg atom-ion collisions, i.e. quantum-, Langevin and classical exchange regimes, showing that for the lowest reachable temperatures a classical treatment is appropriate.

arxiv-2103-17029.creator: Seung-Yeal Ha, Dohyun Kim, Hansol Park
arxiv-2103-17029.description: Abstract . A tensor is a multi-dimensional array of complex numbers, and the Lohe tensor model is an aggregation model on the space of tensors with the same rank and size. It incorporates previously well-studied aggregation models on the space of low-rank tensors such as the Kuramoto model, Lohe sphere and matrix models as special cases.

arxiv-2110-13861.title: On the automorphism groups of rank-4 primitive coherent configurations
arxiv-2110-13861.creator: Bohdan Kivva
arxiv-2110-13861.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Bohdan Kivva. The minimal degree of a permutation group G G is the minimum number of points not fixed by non-identity elements of G G . Lower bounds on the minimal degree have strong structural consequences on G G . Babai conjectured that if a primitive coherent configuration with n n vertices is not a Cameron scheme, then its automorphism group has minimal degree ≥ c ​ n \geq cn for some constant c > 0 c>0 .

arxiv-2307-13889.title: Critical phase induced by Berry phase and dissipation in a spin chain
arxiv-2307-13889.creator: Simon Martin, Tarun Grover
arxiv-2307-13889.description: Abstract Motivated by experiments on spin chains embedded in a metallic bath, as well as closed quantum systems described by long-range interacting Hamiltonians, we study a critical SU ( N ) (N) spin chain perturbed by dissipation, or equivalently, after space-time rotation, long-range spatial interactions.

arxiv-2312-14640.title: The scaling limit of the root component in the Wired Minimal Spanning Forest of the Poisson Weighted Infinite Tree
arxiv-2312-14640.creator: Omer Angel, and, Delphin Sénizergues
arxiv-2312-14640.description: Abstract In this paper we prove a scaling limit result for the component of the root in the Wired Minimal Spanning Forest (WMSF) of the Poisson-Weighted Infinite Tree (PWIT), where the latter tree arises as the local weak limit of the Minimal Spanning Tree (MST) on the complete graph endowed with i.i.d. weights on its edges.

arxiv-2405-02055.title: The CO-dark molecular gas in the cold H i arc
arxiv-2405-02055.creator: Gan Luo, Di Li, Zhi-Yu Zhang, Thomas G. Bisbas, Ningyu Tang, Lingrui Lin, Yichen Sun, Pei Zuo, Jing Zhou
arxiv-2405-02055.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Gan Luo, Di Li, Zhi-Yu Zhang, Thomas G. Bisbas, Ningyu Tang, Lingrui Lin, Yichen Sun, Pei Zuo, Jing Zhou. The CO-dark molecular gas (DMG), which refers to the molecular gas not traced by CO emission, is crucial for the evolution of the interstellar medium (ISM). While the gas properties of DMG have been widely explored in the Solar neighborhood, whether or not they are similar in the outer disk regions of the Milky Way is still not well understood.

arxiv-2506-11071.title: Embedded Acoustic Intelligence for Automotive Systems
arxiv-2506-11071.creator: Renjith Rajagopal, Peter Winzell, Sladjana Strbac, Konstantin Lindström, Petter Hörling, Faisal Kohestani, Niloofar Mehrzad
arxiv-2506-11071.description: Abstract Transforming sound insights into actionable streams of data, this abstract leverages findings from degree thesis research to enhance automotive system intelligence, enabling us to address road type [ 1 ] .By extracting and interpreting acoustic signatures from microphones installed within the wheelbase of a car, we focus on classifying road type.

arxiv-2510-01149.title: ModernVBERT : Towards Smaller Visual Document Retrievers
arxiv-2510-01149.creator: Paul Teiletche, Quentin Macé, Max Conti, Antonio Loison, Gautier Viaud, Pierre Colombo, Manuel Faysse
arxiv-2510-01149.description: Abstract Multimodal embedding models are gaining prevalence, notably for document retrieval as efficient alternatives to text-only pipelines. These models are typically built by finetuning large vision–language decoders (VLMs) with contrastive losses on text–image pairs. In this work, we show that, while cost-efficient, this repurposing approach often bottlenecks retrieval performance.

pmc-10655571.title: Impact of the Hunga Tonga volcanic eruption on stratospheric composition
pmc-10655571.creator: David M. Wilmouth, Freja F. Østerstrøm, Jessica B. Smith, James G. Anderson, Ross J. Salawitch
pmc-10655571.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). SignificanceThe Hunga Tonga-Hunga Ha’apai (HTHH) volcanic eruption on 15 January 2022 is unprecedented in the modern era in both the amount of water vapor injected into the stratosphere and the depth of penetration. The perturbation to water vapor and sulfate aerosols from this volcano significantly altered temperatures, dynamics, and chemistry in the stratosphere, including reductions in stratospheric column ozone, which is essential for protecting life on Earth from harmful ultraviolet radiation.

pmc-10743719.title: How to Diagnose and Risk Stratify Brugada Syndrome. Comment on Matusik et al. Twelve-Lead ECG, Holter Monitoring Parameters, and Genetic Testing in Brugada Syndrome: Insights from Analysis of Multigenerational Family with a History of Sudden Cardiac Arrest during Physical Activity. J. Clin. Med. 202
pmc-10743719.creator: Naoya Kataoka, Teruhiko Imamura
pmc-10743719.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). nd sudden cardiac demise. Matusik and associates have undertaken a comprehensive assessment of a multigenerational family originating from a patient whose life was abruptly extinguished via cardiac arrest, ultimately posthumously diagnosed with Brugada syndrome [1]. Their meticulous investigation reveals that the employment of 12-lead Holter electrocardiogram monitoring, complemented by a judiciously tailored placement of precordial leads, is emerging as a valuable diagnostic tool within the domain of Brugada syndrome, fostering personalized risk stratification in the realm of medical practice.

pmc-11377472.title: Cranial and spinal nerve enhancement in SURF1-associated Leigh syndrome
pmc-11377472.creator: Mhairi Dupré, Richard Warne, Peter Shipman, Maina Kava, Twinkle Ghia, Lily Loughman, Rahul Lakshmanan
pmc-11377472.description: A 23-month-old boy with poor growth, developmental delay, and hypotonia presented with acute onset of ataxia and fatigue. Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) of the brain and spinal cord was performed as part of diagnostic work-up. MRI showed bilateral symmetrical lesions in basal ganglia, midbrain, and brainstem consistent with Leigh syndrome.

pmc-11688024.title: Temporal trends, gender, and ethnoracial disparities in mortality from pulmonary emphysema: A retrospective nationwide analysis
pmc-11688024.creator: Humza Saeed, Muhammad Khubaib Arshad, Syeda Shahnoor, Abdullah, Abdul Wasay, Hareem Mahmood, Zabeehullah, Ajeet Singh, Mohamed Daoud
pmc-11688024.description: Emphysema, a significant global health issue, involves abnormal lung enlargement and wall destruction, affecting 9% to 12% of people worldwide. In the United States (US), 2 million people live with emphysema, with numbers expected to rise. Data on mortality trends and disparities associated with demographic factors is limited, underscoring our study’s focus on analyzing these patterns in US adults.

pmc-12753998.title: Lipid metabolism abnormalities in pediatric abdominal solid malignant tumors: a comprehensive review
pmc-12753998.creator: Qiang Hao, Lu Han, Wenrui Mi, Tingting Hu, Aiqin Lin, Jie Liu
pmc-12753998.description: Pediatric abdominal solid tumors mainly include neuroblastoma, nephroblastoma, hepatoblastoma, and rhabdomyosarcoma. Although significant progress has been made in the treatment of these tumors with the combination of surgery and chemotherapy, the treatment outcomes for some patients remain unsatisfactory, and the mortality rate for late-stage patients is still high.

pmc-13223281.title: An informed monotone neural network for multi-stage chronic kidney disease prediction with integrated GFR estimation
pmc-13223281.creator: Bikram Pratim Bhuyan, Akeel Sh. Mahmoud, Olfa Lamouchi, Galina Ivanova, Amar Ramdane-Cherif
pmc-13223281.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Chronic kidney disease (CKD) is a progressive condition affecting over 850 million people worldwide, where timely detection and accurate staging are critical to reducing morbidity, mortality, and healthcare burden. Current machine learning approaches often treat CKD prediction as a binary task, neglecting the ordered nature of disease stages, and rarely incorporate physiological constraints or calibrated probability estimates essential for clinical decision support.

pmc-13623436.creator: Kmar Turki, Emna Bahloul, Mariem Ennouri, Rim Chaabouni, Sonia Boudaya, Fatma Hammami, Khadija Sellami, Slaheddine Marrakchi, Noura Bougacha, Hamida Turki
pmc-13623436.description: Pyoderma gangrenosum (PG) is a rare neutrophilic dermatosis characterized by rapidly progressive painful ulcers, and increasing evidence supports a role for the interleukin-36 pathway in its pathogenesis. We report the case of a 59-year-old woman with idiopathic refractory PG that evolved over 8 years. The patient had an insufficient response to prolonged systemic corticosteroids and azathioprine, with persistent steroid dependency.
